title: Spec validation receipt
description: Written by `harness validate spec` next to a spec that passed validation, as `<spec file name>.receipt.json` (ADR-0010, Amendment 1). The CLI builds only from a spec whose exact bytes hash to spec_sha256. It proves the bytes are unchanged since a validation, not who validated them.

spec_file.description: Base name of the validated spec file. Information only: the hash binds the content.

spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the spec file's exact bytes, lowercase hex.

spec_schema_id.description: The `$id` of the spec schema the file was validated against.

rules_version.description: SPEC_RULES_VERSION: bumped whenever check_spec or the strict JSON profile gets stricter. The CLI refuses receipts below its built-in minimum.

validated_at.description: UTC time of validation, second precision. Information only, never an expiry.
